card.line: Taberah was a place in the wilderness where the fire of the LORD burned among the complaining Israelites, and its name means "burning."

moments.title: Fire at Taberah
moments.text: The people cried out to Moses, and he prayed to the LORD, and the fire died down. The place was named Taberah, because the fire of the LORD had burned among them.

moments.title: Remembered as a place of provoking
moments.text: Moses later reminded Israel that they kept provoking the LORD at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah.
